Card Q&A.a: No, Tamer cards' [Security] effects aren't inherited effects. Some Tamer cards do have inherited effects, and those can be activated when such cards are placed in digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: If this card has a tamer card as a digivolution card, does the [Security] effect of that tamer card become an inherited effect?
Can this card digivolve on top of a Level 3 Digimon that meets its requirements instead of a tamer card?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it is. However, if the effect specifies Digimon cards, Digi-Egg cards, or any other type of card that isn't a tamer card, it can't be targeted by that effect.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect to make a tamer card into a digivolution card, is that card affected by effects that say "trash digivolution cards"?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you do. Even if you digivolve using a tamer card, make sure to draw 1 card as the digivolution bonus.
Card Q&A.q: If I digivolve this card on top of a tamer card, do I still get the digivolution bonus?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Digivolution doesn't count as playing, so you can attack that turn.
Card Q&A.q: Can I attack the turn I digivolve this card on top of a tamer card?

Card Q&A.a: No. Since it's the first turn the tamer was played, the limitation for attacking on the first turn a card is played still applies.
Card Q&A.q: Can I attack the turn I played a tamer card if I then digivolve this card on top of it?
If I've digivolved this card on top of a tamer card and the Digimon is deleted, what happens to the tamer card?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve. In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?

Effect: You may Digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 Digimon.
